snippet.title: Don't Pick Up | Harvest of Terror: A Horror Game Awards Halloween Showcase 2026 Trailer
snippet.description:
Don't Pick Up is a first-person psychological horror game set in a phone repair shop under an authoritarian regime. As players repair customers' devices, they can snoop through their phones, uncover intimate personal lives, and gradually piece together the disturbing truth hidden beneath the surface of the world around them. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4878690/Dont_Pick_Up/#game_area_purchase
---
Originally aired during HARVEST OF TERROR: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Wednesday 7 October 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
